51606550.DESCRIPTION: Binding affinity to VHL/Elongin C/Elogin B (unknown origin) assessed as dissociation constant at 20 uM by ITC analysis
51606550.references_previous: Testa A, Hughes SJ, Lucas X, Wright JE, Ciulli A. Structure-based design of a macrocyclic PROTAC. Angew Chem Int Ed. 2020;59:1727–1734. https://doi.org/10.1002/anie.201914996.

original_paragraph.Materials and Methods: The ITC experiments were performed on a MicroCal iTC200 instrument (Malvern Panalytical, UK) at 25 °C. The VHL/Elongin C/Elongin B (VCB) complex was prepared as described previously [18]. The protein concentration was 10 μM in 20 mM HEPES, 150 mM NaCl, 1 mM TCEP, pH 7.4. The ligands were dissolved in DMSO and diluted in the same buffer to a final concentration of 100 μM. The VCB complex was loaded into the sample cell (200 μL), and the ligand solution was loaded into the syringe (250 μL). The reference cell was filled with buffer. The titration consisted of 20 injections of 2 μL each, spaced 120 s apart. The stirring speed was set to 300 rpm. The data were analyzed using Origin 7.0 software (OriginLab, Northampton, MA, USA) with a one-site binding model. The binding parameters were calculated from the integrated heat of each injection.
original_paragraph.Figure 5 caption: Fig. 5. Binary ligand binding to VHL as measured by ITC. A) Raw heat and Wiseman plots obtained by VCB titration into MP-1-21 (trans-cyclohexyl). B) Raw heat and Wiseman plots obtained by VCB titration into MP-1-39 (cis-cyclohexyl). C) Thermodynamic parameters related to each binary complex formation.
